ZTA

Zero Trust Architecture

cloudmedium

ZTA is a security design philosophy built on the principle of never trust, always verify. No user or device is trusted by default, even inside the corporate network, and every request is authenticated, authorized, and continuously evaluated. NIST formalized the concept in SP 800-207, and it now underpins most modern cloud and government security strategies.

Sources

  • NIST SP 800-207
